title: Reproducing the Reward-Hack / Verbalization Gap on an Open Reasoning Model

original_idea.body: # Reproducing the Reward-Hack / Verbalization Gap on an Open Reasoning Model. Toy environments with planted hacks; measure exploitation rate and CoT verbalization rate on an open reasoning model; test the length-asymmetry finding.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Open reward-hack verbalization-gap testbed addresses the core threat to CoT monitoring; clear chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Toy hack environments + verbalization counting on open reasoning models; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused gap + length-asymmetry test; building toy environments is moderate effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Fully open reproducible testbed; labs underweight third-party CoT-monitoring tooling.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on open reasoning models, single GPU/API.

novelty.reasoning: Anthropic established the gap at frontier; open-model replication + length test plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Gap established at frontier; open-model replication angle plausibly open.
